item.skyabyss.socket_shard.desc: A socket shard holding the power of %2$s. Crafted from titan materials.
item.skyabyss.socket_shard.tag: Element tag: counts as one %1$s tag while socketed
item.skyabyss.aspect_core.desc: A skill rewrite drawn out of a legendary. Imprint it on a rare weapon or armor piece (one per item).
item.skyabyss.skill_rune.desc: A rune for a single skill. Socket it. Only one rune per skill works.
item.skyabyss.skill_rune.cap: Total modifier power caps at x2.0
gear.skyabyss.hollow: Its rewrite was drawn out; only the mark remains
gear.skyabyss.generation_next: %1$s more generation(s) until a keepsake trait opens
message.skyabyss.gear_generation: %1$s piece(s) of gear gained a generation through the rebirth.
gui.skyabyss.forge.inscribe_help: Place gear. Draw a rewrite from a legendary, imprint a core on a rare, socket shards and runes. The material slot is on the left.
gui.skyabyss.forge.inscribe_no: Only rare-or-better weapons and armor with affixes qualify.
gui.skyabyss.forge.extract_none: Only legendaries with a skill rewrite can be extracted.
gui.skyabyss.forge.extract_hollow: This legendary's rewrite was already drawn out.
gui.skyabyss.forge.extract_destroy_hint: Destroy the legendary and take only the Aspect Core.
gui.skyabyss.forge.extract_keep_hint: The legendary stays; only its rewrite is hollowed out (affixes and upgrades remain).
gui.skyabyss.forge.imprint_rare_only: Cores can only be imprinted on rare weapons or armor.
gui.skyabyss.forge.imprint_help: Place an Aspect Core in the material slot.
gui.skyabyss.forge.sockets_none: No sockets. "Add socket" below always opens one.
gui.skyabyss.forge.insert_help: Place a shard or rune in the material slot.
gui.skyabyss.forge.insert_dup: This item already has a rune for that skill.
gui.skyabyss.forge.add_socket_hint: Open a socket without luck (max 2). Uses crystals and the origin titan's material.
